puck_synth_frames — DRIVE puck op

• Datenarten: table × table × signal × signal → table

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.puck_synth_frames(table: 'dict', cam: 'dict', p0, v0, *, fps: 'float' = 120.0, n_frames: 'int' = 24, exposure: 'float' = 0.0, noise: 'float' = 0.0, rng=None, model: 'str' = 'coulomb') -> 'dict' (die Implementierung direkt: import puck; puck.puck_synth_frames(table: 'dict', cam: 'dict', p0, v0, *, fps: 'float' = 120.0, n_frames: 'int' = 24, exposure: 'float' = 0.0, noise: 'float' = 0.0, rng=None, model: 'str' = 'coulomb') -> 'dict'; aus dem Register: opsdrive.get("puck_synth_frames"))

Verwendung

> Für diesen Operator gibt es noch keine Übersetzung. Es folgt der Originaltext unverändert.

合成の連続コマと真値: 閉形式の経路(:func:puck_slide_predict)を fps で標本化し :func:puck_render_frame で描く。

返り値 `{"frames" [N], "t" (N,), "truth_xy" (N,2) 露光始めの位置, "truth_v" (N,2), "truth_px" (N,2), "pred", "cam", "fps", "exposure"}`。
